summary: Collects experience from building ENUM systems, which map telephone numbers to internet identifiers using DNS, and from the ENUM data others have created. It clarifies the ENUM and DDDS specifications and points out pitfalls so later implementers can avoid them.

eli5.summary: ENUM lets you look up a phone number the way you look up a website name. This note is a list of lessons from people who built it, to help newcomers avoid the same mistakes.
